title: Mental Model Check: Realtime Sync Engine v2
description: Verify your understanding of the latest storage, transport, and staleness decisions.

questions.prompt: Which persistence layer did dec_003 adopt to replace the earlier Redis Pub/Sub proposal?
options: Git-backed plain YAML/Markdown files + append-only events.jsonl
questions.explanation: dec_003 superseded dec_001 to eliminate external daemon dependencies and make every context update git-diffable and merge-friendly.

questions.prompt: What happens automatically when a new Decision supersedes an older Decision ID?
options: Old diagrams and videos are permanently deleted
Artifacts referencing the old Decision are flagged as Stale, and behind Sessions show revision lag
Nothing until you manually edit every Markdown file
All connected agents are immediately terminated
questions.explanation: ContextDeck preserves history while surfacing exact staleness reasons on dependent artifacts and missed events on drifted sessions.

questions.prompt: How can a web-only harness like Grok (without local MCP support) stay synced with a board?
options: By copying the 1-click Context Pack into chat and pasting back its structured JSON update
By installing a browser kernel driver
Only by committing directly to GitHub
questions.explanation: Context Packs + Paste Update let zero-tool web chats read the current mental model and contribute decisions, tasks, and summaries back.
